title: D&D Beyond Spell Slot Burn Rate
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:character class_name=* spell_slot_burn_pct=*
| stats avg(spell_slot_burn_pct) as avg_spell_slot_burn_pct, count as events by class_name
| sort - avg_spell_slot_burn_pct
description: Shows average spell-slot burn percentage by class for spell resource usage.
value: Average spell-slot burn percentage by class helps compare spell resource usage across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `spell_slot_burn_pct` on `rpg:character` events and normalize `class_name` so Splunk can summarize performance by class.
visualization: Bar chart of average spell-slot burn percentage by class.
grandmaExplanation: It records the average spell-slot burn percentage for each class so you can see what works best for spell resource usage.
